sentences.en: In the last year, there have been a series of news stories about academics and activists who falsely claimed they were Black, or Latinx, or Native American.

sentences.en: I was interested in the stories themselves, but also in the way they were covered in the news, and how they were read and talked about by the rest of us.
sentences.zh: 我不仅对这些故事本身感兴趣，还对新闻报道它们的方式，以及我们其他人如何解读和谈论它们感兴趣。

sentences.en: I wanted to look deeper at the structures and systems and people that allow this particular form of deception to persist, and how we might begin to deal with it.

sentences.zh: 这份忏悔书发布才几分钟，但已经有六个朋友转发了链接给她。

sentences.zh: 她和考阿努伊在近25年前相识，当时考阿努伊是加州大学圣克鲁兹分校“意识史”项目的一名28岁研究生，

sentences.zh: “她将自己定位为切罗基人，”她告诉我。

sentences.zh: “她在申请书中提到了一些关于远离家园的城市美洲原住民意味着什么的内容。”

sentences.zh: 考阿努伊是卡纳卡毛利人，即夏威夷原住民。

sentences.en: But she grew up in Southern California, and she knew what it felt like to belong ancestrally to one place, but be raised somewhere else.
sentences.zh: 但她在南加州长大，她知道那种在血缘上属于一个地方，却在别处长大的感觉。

sentences.zh: 纠结，这让考阿努伊感到兴奋。她推动了史密斯的录取，并在她被录取后立即联系了她。

sentences.en: Over time, the two became good friends, just as Kauanui had hoped, though she quickly realized that Smith didn't want to talk about her family or her Native roots.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，两人成了好朋友，正如考阿努伊所希望的那样，尽管她很快意识到史密斯不想谈论她的家庭或她的原住民血统。

sentences.en: For years, all she would tell Kauanui was that she was from Long Beach, California, that her

sentences.zh: 母亲是俄克拉荷马州的切罗基人，祖父母也是，而她的父亲虽然不在身边，但却是奥吉布瓦人。

sentences.en: There was a Cherokee community in California, and Kauanui assumed for a while that Smith was part of that group.
sentences.zh: 加州有一个切罗基社区，考阿努伊一度认为史密斯是那个群体的一部分。

sentences.en: She assumed a lot, she realized in retrospect, filling in the blanks that Smith left in her story so that it would make sense.
sentences.zh: 她意识到，回想起来，她假设了很多，填补了史密斯故事中的空白，好让它说得通。

sentences.en: Even 25 years later, when she knew that so much of what she first believed wasn't true, Kauanui still grappled with what to make of everything
sentences.zh: 即使在25年后，当她知道自己最初相信的很多事情都不是真的时，考阿努伊仍然在努力理解史密斯

sentences.en: Smith had said, or hadn't said.
sentences.zh: 说过或没说过的一切。

sentences.en: And yet, unlike Krug or the others who confessed and then disappeared from the public eye, Smith never explained herself or the lies she told.

sentences.en: She has never really had to.

sentences.zh: 那天下午晚些时候，考阿努伊在餐桌上的笔记本电脑上重读了克鲁格的“罪己诏”，她想到了那场从未发生的清算。

sentences.zh: 尽管姐妹俩在芝加哥只待了几年，但她们给人留下了深刻印象。
